About the title lettering

The title is set in Atlas 1900, a working reconstruction traced from the gilt lettering on the cover of the 1900 Atlas des anciens plans de Paris (David Rumsey Map Collection).

From the cover: A D E G I L N P R S T

Not confident. F M U Y are stand-ins from a related face, Cochard & David's Lettres monumentales (Paris, c.1880). We made Î Ô ourselves from the cover's I and O, with a circumflex built from its acute accent.

Missing altogether: the comma, shown here in Cormorant SC.

Atlas plates: David Rumsey Map Collection, Stanford Libraries, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (all 113 items). Other plans: BnF / Gallica.
